artifacts.minimum_depth: all material company, restructuring, market, industry, order and broker claims have a registered source
artifacts.blocking_conditions: missing source tier or weak evidence used as primary support
artifacts.verifier_check: source registry exists and material claims resolve

artifacts.minimum_depth: every valuation-material claim and exclusion resolves to a governed source or an explicit block
artifacts.blocking_conditions: unsupported claim or weak lead enters valuation
artifacts.verifier_check: claim-to-source resolution and exclusion consistency

artifacts.minimum_depth: all material unresolved company, order, industry and broker evidence paths are recorded
artifacts.blocking_conditions: missing target, order or industry evidence is silently omitted
artifacts.verifier_check: exhaustion log and residual-risk wording agree

artifacts.minimum_depth: reported data reconciled to official filings with actual, pro-forma and derived fields clearly separated
artifacts.blocking_conditions: unreconciled profit, share-count, backlog, debt or cash-flow numbers
artifacts.verifier_check: verified financial artifact and official source paths exist

artifacts.minimum_depth: each material profit pool has a price, mix, delivery, cost and cash-conversion bridge with evidence limitations
artifacts.blocking_conditions: generic shipbuilding-cycle prose used to support earnings or valuation
artifacts.verifier_check: required cyclical coverage-pack modules are present

artifacts.minimum_depth: the entire shipbuilding chain is covered and machine classification contains exactly one valuation parent, 600150.SH; subsidiaries are consolidated components
artifacts.blocking_conditions: subsidiaries counted as separate core securities or company share inferred from country or group share
artifacts.verifier_check: full-chain artifacts exist, node fields resolve and core valuation parent count equals one

artifacts.minimum_depth: every material row is traceable and distinguishes consolidated valuation from granular or SOTP blocks
artifacts.blocking_conditions: generic source labels, group-to-listed attribution, binary blocker ambiguity or missing R1 sensitivity
artifacts.verifier_check: row-level provenance and method-specific blockers are present

artifacts.minimum_depth: all material customer and order claims are audited one-to-one with exact sources and valuation boundaries
artifacts.blocking_conditions: order attribution or customer economics lacks exact source or usage boundary
artifacts.verifier_check: customer row schema, provenance and method restrictions

artifacts.minimum_depth: the 600150 card includes balance-sheet and investment needs and each material gap is consumed by R1
artifacts.blocking_conditions: missing cash, debt or capex, or a material gap not translated into a model sensitivity or block
artifacts.verifier_check: company-card fields and R1 gap consumption are explicit

artifacts.minimum_depth: every material missing field is routed to a model restriction, sensitivity or monitor
artifacts.blocking_conditions: binary blocker ambiguity or unconsumed R1 gap
artifacts.verifier_check: gap semantics and model consumption

artifacts.minimum_depth: country, group and company claims remain at their evidenced perimeter
artifacts.blocking_conditions: country or group share used as 600150 share or unarchived exact statistic published
artifacts.verifier_check: competition perimeter and source-tier boundary

artifacts.minimum_depth: disclosed totals connect to model drivers without direct backlog conversion or order double counting
artifacts.blocking_conditions: backlog becomes revenue or EPS, or COSCO order is counted twice
artifacts.verifier_check: order-to-earnings boundary and validation thresholds

artifacts.minimum_depth: original PDFs or broker official pages prioritized; weak rows retained with zero weight
artifacts.blocking_conditions: search snippets, previews or reposts treated as original Street targets
artifacts.verifier_check: broker packet covers 600150 and source-exhaustion gaps

artifacts.minimum_depth: backlog, price, mix and delivery convert to company revenue, margin, net profit and EPS without double-counting restructuring
artifacts.blocking_conditions: gross backlog treated as revenue, unsupported group-to-listed attribution, or missing driver-to-EPS bridge
artifacts.verifier_check: growth artifacts expose required fields and reconcile to official/perimeter evidence

artifacts.minimum_depth: cycle-normalized, restructuring-aware valuation with explicit share/perimeter and order-conversion assumptions
artifacts.blocking_conditions: single-quarter annualization, pre-restructuring denominator mismatch, single-multiple target, unreconciled shares or unsupported Street anchor
artifacts.verifier_check: all disclosed valuation arithmetic reproduces

artifacts.minimum_depth: structured row reproduces the legally effective share bridge, scenarios and final published target or range
artifacts.blocking_conditions: missing fields, target/upside mismatch or stale scenario values
artifacts.verifier_check: structured row fields and target/upside arithmetic

artifacts.minimum_depth: every final valuation number is recalculated from disclosed inputs
artifacts.blocking_conditions: Model Reproducibility is not PASS
artifacts.verifier_check: literal Model Reproducibility: PASS and arithmetic checks

required_fields: adjustment label and raw K-line path
Shanghai Connect and fund report dates
artifacts.minimum_depth: each published secondary-market statement has a dated source and frequency boundary; strict free float and daily Connect flow are sourced or explicitly bounded with archived evidence
artifacts.blocking_conditions: generic absence language, unlabelled adjusted history, circulating shares relabelled as free float, quarterly holdings presented as daily flow, or unsourced capital-flow claim
artifacts.verifier_check: raw-response paths, data frequency and reader-facing chapter reconcile

artifacts.minimum_depth: 40-60 pages, prose-led chapters, readable exhibits and Chinese reader-facing logic
artifacts.blocking_conditions: compile failure, clipped core exhibits, table-only main body, untranslated recommendation logic or placeholder text
artifacts.verifier_check: XeLaTeX build, PDF metadata, text extraction and rendered-page inspection

artifacts.minimum_depth: clean MacTeX XeLaTeX build and visually reviewed publication PDF
artifacts.blocking_conditions: missing PDF, page-count breach, clipping, unreadable tables or placeholder text
artifacts.verifier_check: PDF metadata, extracted text and rendered-page inspection

artifacts.minimum_depth: investment conclusion, model, evidence, actions and residual risks are mutually consistent
artifacts.blocking_conditions: PASS with open S/A issues, failing verifier or material residual-risk conflict
artifacts.verifier_check: research gate validates final sign-off
